query:
SELECT
                COUNT(CASE WHEN checkpoint_id < $2 THEN 1 END) as claimed_proofs,
                COUNT(CASE WHEN checkpoint_id >= $2 THEN 1 END) as unclaimed_proofs,
                COUNT(*) as total_proofs
            FROM worker_events
            WHERE public_key = $1
                AND topic = $3
                AND status = 'COMPLETED'
